title: Audio Scribe
clip_body: Record a note inside OfflineAid or import an existing clip. Recording stays on-device and becomes the active Audio Scribe source as soon as you stop.
result_empty: Record or import a clip to begin.
transcribe_error_still_recording: Stop recording before you start Audio Scribe.
mic_permission_error: Microphone permission is required to record an Audio Scribe clip.
web_only_error: Recording is only available in the native OfflineAid app.
audio_only_error: Audio Scribe is only available in the native OfflineAid app.
android_offline_speech_guide: AI Scribe (Gemma) can run without system speech. For system transcription, open Language settings and download the offline speech pack for your locale.
offline_speech_setup_body: Install the Google offline speech pack: Settings, System, Languages and input, Voice, Offline speech recognition. Then download your language.
save_clip_error: Could not save the audio clip.
recording_no_file: The recording finished, but no audio file was returned.
load_ai_scribe_model_error: Load Gemma 4 E2B LiteRT-LM on Android before using AI Scribe.
import_or_record_error: Import or record an audio clip first.
android_speech_unavailable: Android Speech is not available on this device.
android_speech_transcribe_failed: Android Speech could not transcribe this clip.
apple_speech_unavailable: Apple Speech is not available on this device.
load_ai_scribe_named_model: Load {{modelName}} on Android before using AI Scribe.
load_chat_model_for_english: Load any chat model to translate into English.
load_chat_model_for_system: Load a chat model for system-language translation.
process_clip_error: Audio Scribe could not process that clip.
path_hint_gemma: {{modelName}} · multilingual, on-device LLM. Fine-tuned on Australian government safety corpus.
speech_engine_unavailable_hint: Load {{modelName}} or install offline speech packs.
format_transcript_a11y: Show transcript. Runs transcription if not cached.
format_english_a11y: Show English translation. Runs translation if not cached.
format_language_a11y: Show {{language}} translation. Runs translation if not cached.
